“gold pans” renders “kappot (ladles) of gold,” and “ten shekels apiece” renders “ten, ten the ladle.”
“oxen” renders “cattle (baqar),” and “the male goats” renders “attudim,” he-goats.
“the voice speaking” renders a reflexive form, “the voice speaking itself”; “so He spoke to him” renders “and he spoke to him,” whose subject is not named.
